evidence_legend.edge-vote: at least one clean single-occurrence scoreboard edge vote agrees with the class role; margins in votes3.json; sibling-noise known at ~15-20%
evidence_legend.class: SASS-wide operand-order semantics as rendered by nvdisasm on certified encodings; no clean edge evidence in R0b
evidence_legend.q1-2026-08-20: desc[UR][Rx.64] base = ONE 32-bit offset register (7 bases never have x+1 anywhere in the certified kernel; odd bases legal; producers are 32-bit MOV/IADD3 without carry)

address_suffix_widths.note: desc_base: .64 on desc[UR][Rx.64] marks 64-bit EFFECTIVE address (UR descriptor + 32-bit offset reg); NOT a register pair (Q1). plain [Rx.64] pair kept for non-desc forms (unobserved in R0b).

shape_overrides.load_two_reg_split: load class: modifier .256 with >=2 leading top-level R operands => each leading R def spans width/2 (LDG.E.*.256.STRONG.GPU Rhi, Rlo, desc[...]); census edge-votes DEF on pos1; fixes M3 hand-rule (pos2 dest misread as USE + span overreach)
shape_overrides.store_two_reg_split: store class: modifier .256 with 2 top-level R data operands => each data R use spans width/2 (STG.E.*.256 desc[..], Ra, Rb); fixes M3 'both tokens span 8' superset
